title: Prioritize & deduplicate
summary: Rank consequences and change exposure rather than precise-looking guessed scores.

sections.label: Assessment dimensions
items: Consequence for users or domain correctness.
Frequency of changes in the affected area.

sections.label: Ticket discipline
sections.text: Cluster duplicate findings, inspect root causes, and have an owner triage before creating many tickets. One root cause may explain several warnings.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Priority explains why this outcome is worth addressing now. Estimates disclose uncertainty and do not pretend Sonar costs equal delivery effort.

catalog.applicability: Use when many findings or warnings have been collected and you must decide which deserve tickets now. It ranks by consequence and change exposure, clusters duplicates by root cause and keeps estimate uncertainty visible.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
